title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

title: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

But Tsumugi gently takes his hand and says with a smile, “Hatori-sensei is such a liar." Teacher and student… two people who should not get too close. synopsis: Despite her hidden genius, Avril has lived a life of misery, constantly belittled as useless by her own family. When she is forced to substitute for her wicked step-sister in a marriage to a supposedly lecherous, old duke, Avril expects the worst. But surprisingly, Duke Dylan is actually a breathtakingly handsome young man. He offers her a deal: act as his villainess wife for three years, and then they will divorce. For Avril, this contract is a golden ticket to her ultimate freedom. But as she enthusiastically embraces her new evil persona, her mysterious charm leaves the duke and his household completely bewildered and entirely enchanted. (Source: Kadokawa)

Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.
